_readme: Labelled complaint texts for CC-14 evaluation.
Deliberately mixed so the comparison is honest rather than rigged:
keyword  - names the thing outright. Rules should win, and the model
implicit - describes the fault without naming the object ('the thing on
the ceiling stopped spinning'). Rules cannot do this.
trap     - contains a word the rules key on, but about something else
('wasp nest outside the WINDOW'). Rules-first means these are
misclassified and never reach the model, which is the main
cost of the design and must be measured, not hidden.
other    - genuinely does not fit a category.
expectedCategory null means no category is correct.
